A2. Our format choices
73%
smaller preview file
For the My AITU / LMS bridge, we use WebP at quality 80 for the
attendance preview. At the same 390 × 844 resolution, its file size
falls from 58.39 KiB to 15.75 KiB, saving 42.64 KiB, or 73.0%. We
retain PNG as the original evidence image because it preserves text
and edges without lossy compression. Inline SVG suits interface icons
because vectors stay sharp at different sizes and share the HTML
response. CSS provides the login pulse without a separate video
download. For the project demonstration, we plan MP4 with H.264
video and AAC audio for broad playback support. JPEG settings and
the ten-second clip still need measured comparison before we can
report their quality or size.
